# Tanmay Sahare

> Founder of VarshaKrishi Udhyog Pvt. Ltd. — building affordable agricultural intelligence for Indian smallholder farmers. B.Tech Aerospace Engineering student at IIT Kanpur; startup incubated at SIIC IIT Kanpur.

## Who
Tanmay Sahare is an Indian engineer and founder. He builds offline-first, solar-powered LoRa IoT sensor networks and satellite-based crop advisory systems (Sentinel-2 / NASA HLS imagery, NDVI/NDRE/EVI/NDWI) that deliver plain-language advisories to farmers in 8 Indian languages. His platforms use literature-cited agronomy models (FAO-56 evapotranspiration for irrigation, TOMCAST DSV for disease risk) and seal every derived record in per-field SHA-256 hash chains for tamper-evident field history.

## Work
- VarshaKrishi (flagship): https://www.varshakrishi.com — agricultural intelligence infrastructure (IoT + satellite advisory)
- CORE: automated portfolio risk engine for retail investors (fintech/quant)
- TweetTracker: NLP sentiment analysis of Indian policy discourse
- Leadership: Chess Club Coordinator IIT Kanpur (6,000+ participant tournament); Manager, Policy Research (PPOC IIT Kanpur)
